description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Samwise, adding {C}{C}.
When Samwise dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Samwise that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Samwise token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning up to one applicable card from your graveyard to your hand, and then causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Samwise token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Repeat.
